notablePrerequisites: You control at least five creatures.
description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Sprout Swarm with buyback by paying {4}{G}, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token and returning Sprout Swarm to your hand.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Saproling, untapping Gaea's Cradle.
Repeat.
